trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated** — Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions. The first attempt halted after us-east (orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollback completed successfully.
3. **Verified** — All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with an error rate of ~0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the health-check failures, the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and the current healthy status. The first incident-creation call timed out, but the retry with the same idempotency key succeeded exactly once.
